facts.statement: Tenant reported on 6 May 2025 that the shower and hot water were not working and that the boiler had no power despite the switch being checked.
The agency acknowledged the report on 6 May 2025 and treated the loss of hot water as urgent.
The file was categorised as Electrical on the strength of 'no boiler power'; no inspection, diagnosis or agency contractor attendance is recorded.
The landlord, Ravi Sethi, elected to arrange his own contractor on 6 May and the agency approval workflow was stopped; no agency appointment was booked.
On 11 May the tenant reported 'Nothing done about it'; on 13 May the tenant again reported no hot water and that nobody had attended.

On 12 May the landlord said his plumber would likely attend that evening and that the agency could send its own contractor the next day if he did not; no agency contractor was booked and no amount or cap was named.

On 15 May the landlord said his plumber attended on 14 May and fixed the issue, based on a text from the plumber; no work description, report, invoice or record of boiler/electrical checks was provided.
The tenant has not confirmed restoration: a voicemail and an email on 15 May are unanswered as at the last entry on 16 May.
The tenant reported a non-working letterbox on 13 May and the agency promised to follow up; no detail or assessment was recorded.
No standing spend cap or landlord standing instruction is on file for this property, and no landlord message approves a priced agency job.
Access notes: a household member may be at home but does not speak English, and small birds are kept at the property.

Maya Chen, Northbridge Lettings
